description: OpenLIT's OpenAI instrumentation: one chat with a tool call, the answer, then one embedding call, with an empty local price table.
notes: openlit 1.45.0 in envs/openlit (its own environment: openlit needs openai<3, D-IN-26 item 1). openlit.init is called before any tracer provider exists, so OpenLIT builds its own and exports through otlp_endpoint, the receiver origin: the span exporter prefers the runner's OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT, and OpenLIT's events logger posts to <endpoint>/v1/logs, which the receiver accepts and discards. disable_metrics=True keeps the meter off, and disabled_instrumentors turns the HTTP client instrumentors off, which otherwise add a POST span per model call (spike finding 10). pricing.json in the scenario directory holds an empty table, so OpenLIT fetches nothing and no row matches: it reports gen_ai.usage.cost = 0 (spike finding 2). Under Q2 (a) a reported total of exactly 0 on a span with tokens counts as no report (D-IN-26 item 14), so both llm spans and the embedding span are priced from the price table, never from OpenLIT. Expected: llm, llm, embedding. openlit.agent.version_hash changes on every process start (spike finding 9): a placeholder. gen_ai.server.time_to_first_token is measured (written even without streaming): timing.
